title: Choosing a Research Method for a School Garden Project
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。短文和问题均为英语，解释为中文。所有内容为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。请先通读全文，再做题。答案必须来自原文。
passage:
Last month, a group of students at Greenfield Secondary School started a small research project. They wanted to find out how a school garden affects students' stress levels. The team leader, Mia, explained the plan to the class. "We need to choose a method," she said. "We can either give out a questionnaire or interview a few students." The group discussed the options for a week. In the end, they decided to use a questionnaire because it is quick and easy to collect many answers. Although questionnaires are useful, they cannot capture detailed personal stories. While interviews take more time, they provide deeper information. The students agreed to use both methods: a questionnaire for all 30 students and interviews with five volunteers. This mixed-method approach allowed them to gather both broad and deep information, which is important for a small-scale study.

After collecting the data, the team analyzed the results. They found that 70% of students felt calmer after spending time in the garden. However, because of the small sample size, the results may not apply to all students. Mia wrote in her report: "Although the garden seems to help, we need more data to be sure." The group also noted that while some students enjoyed gardening, others preferred just sitting quietly. Because the project was short, they could not observe long-term effects. The teacher, Mr. Chen, reminded them to be honest about limitations. He said, "Because of your careful work, the results are useful, but remember they are only a starting point." Being honest about limitations is an important part of any research, as it helps others understand how much confidence to place in the findings.

For the final presentation, the team created a poster with three sections: method, results, and conclusion. They used a topic sentence for each section. For example, the method section began: "We used a mixed-method approach to gather both broad and deep information." The results section started: "Most students reported feeling calmer after garden time." The conclusion stated: "While the garden may reduce stress, more research is needed." The team learned that a clear topic sentence helps the reader understand the main idea. They also practiced supporting sentences with reasons and examples. Mia said, "Because we planned carefully, our presentation was strong." The project taught them how to choose a method and how to write a clear argument. These skills will be useful in future studies and presentations.

grammar.title: 主题句与支持句；although / while；because 与 because of
grammar.explanation: 在段落写作中，主题句（topic sentence）告诉读者这一段的主要意思，通常放在段首。支持句（supporting sentences）用理由、例子或细节来支持主题句。连接词 although 和 while 表示让步或对比，后面接完整的句子（主语+谓语）。because 后面接句子，because of 后面接名词或名词短语。例如：Although it rained, we went out. / While I like tea, she likes coffee. / We stayed home because it was cold. / We stayed home because of the cold weather.
grammar.example: Although questionnaires are useful, they cannot capture detailed personal stories.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ the garden is small, it is very beautiful.
questions.explanation: 这里表示让步“虽然”，后面接完整句子，用 Although。
questions.evidence: Although questionnaires are useful, they cannot capture detailed personal stories.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: She likes reading ______ her brother likes sports.
questions.explanation: 这里表示对比“而”，用 while 连接两个完整句子。
questions.evidence: While interviews take more time, they provide deeper information.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: We stayed inside ______ the heavy rain.
questions.explanation: because of 后面接名词短语 the heavy rain，表示原因。
questions.evidence: because of the small sample size, the results may not apply to all students.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: He was late ______ he missed the bus.
questions.explanation: because 后面接完整句子 he missed the bus，表示原因。
questions.evidence: they decided to use a questionnaire because it is quick and easy to collect many answers.

questions.prompt: Which is a good topic sentence for a paragraph about exercise?
options: Exercise has many benefits for health.
I went to the gym yesterday.
answers: Exercise has many benefits for health.
questions.explanation: 主题句应概括整段主要意思，Exercise has many benefits for health 是一个概括性观点，适合做主题句。
questions.evidence: We used a mixed-method approach to gather both broad and deep information.

options: Although it was raining, we played football.
Although it was raining, but we played football.
Although the rain, we played football.
answers: Although it was raining, we played football.
questions.explanation: although 后面接完整句子，且不能与 but 同时使用。
questions.evidence: Although questionnaires are useful, they cannot capture detailed personal stories.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ the project was short, they could not observe long-term effects.
questions.explanation: 这里表示原因，后面接完整句子 the project was short，用 Because。
questions.evidence: Because the project was short, they could not observe long-term effects.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ the bad weather, the event was cancelled.
questions.explanation: because of 后接名词短语 the bad weather，表示原因。
questions.evidence: because of the small sample size, the results may not apply to all students.
